purpose: Turn our own external-line probabilities into one obvious default pick per Hotspawn CS2 fixture, and mark the few underdogs that are contrarian but not stupid. Pure rules: same inputs give the same output; nothing here is a source fact.

allowed: Valve official standings model (uncalibrated, never eligible for a swap)
never_used: point multipliers as a signal of team strength

scoring.formula: offered_points = floor(base_points x game_multiplier x tier_multiplier x series_multiplier x stage_multiplier x tournament_multiplier)

lock.label: Lock
lock.advice: Take the favorite. Picking the underdog here is a donation, not a contrarian play.

lean.label: Lean
lean.advice: Favorite by a clear margin. Only a sourced, specific edge could justify the underdog, and none is checked automatically.

live_dog.label: Live dog
live_dog.advice: The underdog has a real shot: about one chance in three or better. Contrarian candidate when the line is money-backed.

coin_flip.label: Coin flip
coin_flip.advice: Either side is defensible. The default is the side the lines make slightly more likely.

swap_rule: The line is money-backed (Polymarket, bookmaker or their median), not the Valve model.
The line was observed no more than 8 hours before the page was built.
The underdog is at least 30% to win in our own probability.
The match is worth at least 3 Hotspawn points (B tier or higher).
The crowd is not already on the underdog. If 10 or more Hotspawn pickers are on record and at least half of them picked the underdog, the play is skipped: it cannot move you past anyone.
The match has not locked. At most 2 plays are recommended per UTC calendar day, ranked by points x underdog probability x the share of the field you would pass.
field_share_policy: Hotspawn '% picked' never changes a probability, a class or a favorite. It has exactly one limited use, switched by use_field_for_leverage: an upset play is skipped when the crowd is already on the underdog (a sample of 10 or more pickers, at least half on the underdog), and the remaining plays are ranked by the share of the field they would pass (a neutral 0.5 weight when the field is unknown). Samples under 30 pickers are labelled small.
unverified: Streak bonus formula: the rules page says consecutive correct picks earn bonus points but publishes no formula, so the cost of breaking a streak is not quantified.
Exact weekly reset instant: only a countdown on the lobby was observed.
Whether wrong picks are ever penalised: the rules page mentions points only for correct picks and no deduction for wrong ones.
